gamerule.tallyhopper.max_offline_hours.d: The most real-world time one closed session can earn. Longer gaps are cut, and players are told.
gamerule.tallyhopper.backlog_cap.descrip: The most items one hopper's backlog holds. Credit beyond it is not created; stored items are never removed.
gamerule.tallyhopper.max_items_per_hour: Tally Hopper: max items per hour
The most one hopper credits per hour, across every item. The default is what a hopper can physically move, so a farm is never held back by it.
gamerule.tallyhopper.min_observation_min: How long a hopper watches its farm before its measured rate earns credit (1 to 60).
gamerule.tallyhopper.rejoin_summary.desc: Tell players in chat what their hoppers earned while the world was closed.
